en: Sepia-toned historical postcard depicting a large market square framed by arcaded townhouses on the left and a prominent town hall with a tall clock tower on the right. People are walking and standing in the open square, with trees lining part of the right side. German text is printed at the top left identifying the scene as the arcades of the market and the town hall in Hirschberg.
